In the Expected result box under the last step, write what the screen should show at the end. One expected result covers the whole case.
Click Edit.

Pick your file type under Format, then click Next.
Check the settings. For most files, pick Each row is a single test case.

Click Create test run +.
Pick a Start Date and a Due Date. Both are required. Next stays off until you set them.

Choose Failed. The Submit new status window opens.
Pick at least one tag in Tags. Tags are required.
Type a Name for the defect. It is the only required field. Add a Description. Leave Source on TestFiesta.
